name.value: Pomeroy Hotel & Conference Centre Fort St. John

description.value: The Pomeroy Hotel & Conference Centre is a large full-service hotel in Fort St. John, positioned along the Alaska Highway in Northern BC — a key waypoint for long-distance touring cyclists crossing into or out of the Peace Region. The property features an indoor pool, whirlpool, waterslide, 24-hour fitness centre, and a range of room types from standard doubles to full kitchen suites. It is connected directly to Chances Casino and offers complimentary parking with big-truck accommodation.

address.value: 11308 Alaska Road North, Fort St. John, BC V1J 5T5
